latest.title: Continuity of the renormalised volume between Epstein surfaces with respect to the Weil--Petersson topology
latest.abstract: We prove that the renormalised volume between the two Epstein surfaces generated by a Weil--Petersson quasicircle is continuous with respect to the Weil--Petersson topology. As a consequence, we prove that the universal Liouville action is proportional to this renormalised volume for any Weil--Petersson quasicircle.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 证明由 Weil–Petersson 拟圆生成的两张 Epstein 曲面之间的重整化体积关于 Weil–Petersson 拓扑连续，并推出普适 Liouville 作用量与该体积成比例。
techniques: 共形映射与 Liouville 作用量
latest.breakthrough: 把此前的光滑/逼近关系延伸到整个 Weil–Petersson 拟圆类，并稳定连接三维双曲体积与二维作用量。
latest.limitations: 连续性结论限定 Weil–Petersson 类；对更粗拟圆拓扑或定量模连续性未给出。
latest.aiEvidence: 作者使用 ChatGPT 5.6 辅助概念形成和计算；数学验证、最终证明决策与文字由作者负责。
latest.priorityReason: 在 Teichmüller/双曲几何交界建立稳健延拓，具有较强结构意义。
